verdict.rationale: Twenty documents running the product on your own infrastructure with a single Docker Compose command, a one-line install script, and a step-by-step Docker Compose guide. It also positions self-hosting as a core use case for privacy-conscious organizations, and community comments confirm it is open source under AGPLv3. Missing for 10: explicit independent hands-on corroboration of a self-hosted deployment, and documentation of feature parity between self-hosted and cloud editions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
